mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,actor_id,action,category,outcome,resource_type,resource_id,message,trace_id,payload,created_at FROM nw_audit_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id,actor_id,action,category,outcome,resource_type,message,trace_id,created_at FROM nw_audit_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id,tenant_id,actor_id,action,category,outcome,resource_type,resource_id,message,trace_id,created_at FROM nw_audit_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_audit_read_batches(audit_id,scope,actor_id,authorization_version,query_digest, window_start,window_end,filter_action,filter_actor_id,filter_category,filter_outcome,filter_resource_type, filter_trace_id,filter_from,filter_to,filter_from_epoch_second,filter_from_nano, filter_to_epoch_second,filter_to_nano) VALUES(#{auditId},#{scope},#{actorId},#{authorizationVersion},#{queryDigest},#{windowStart},#{windowEnd}, #{query.action},#{query.actorId},#{query.category},#{query.outcome},#{query.resourceType},#{query.traceId}, #{query.from},#{query.to}, #{query.from.epochSecond},#{query.from.nano}NULL,NULL, #{query.to.epochSecond},#{query.to.nano}NULL,NULL) ON CONFLICT(scope,actor_id,authorization_version,query_digest,window_start) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM nw_audit_logs WHERE AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT scope,resource,retention_days,enabled,version FROM nw_foundation_retention_policies WHERE scope=#{scope} AND resource=#{resource}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_retention_policies(scope,resource,retention_days,enabled,version) VALUES(#{scope},#{resource},#{retentionDays},#{enabled},#{version}) ON CONFLICT(scope,resource) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_retention_policies SET retention_days=#{days},enabled=#{enabled},version=version+1,updated_at=now() WHERE scope=#{scope} AND resource='audit' AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id,scope,actor_id,resource,policy_version,cutoff,candidate_ids::text AS candidate_ids,candidates,protected_count,deleted_count,status,expires_at,created_at,completed_at,failure_code FROM nw_foundation_cleanup_runs WHERE scope=#{scope} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,scope,actor_id,resource,policy_version,cutoff,candidate_ids::text AS candidate_ids,candidates,protected_count,deleted_count,status,expires_at,created_at,completed_at,failure_code FROM nw_foundation_cleanup_runs WHERE scope=#{scope} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_cleanup_runs SET status=#{status},deleted_count=#{deleted},protected_count=CASE WHEN #{protectedCount}<0 THEN protected_count ELSE #{protectedCount} END, failure_code=#{failure},completed_at=now() WHERE scope=#{scope} AND id=#{id} AND status='ready'
mapper.select: SELECT id,scope,audit_id,reason,expires_at,released_at FROM nw_foundation_audit_holds WHERE scope=#{scope} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_audit_holds SET released_at=now() WHERE scope=#{scope} AND id=#{id} AND released_at IS NULL
